# Aleksei Bespechnyi – Full Profile & Knowledge Base

> Comprehensive professional profile, academic background, research projects, and skills inventory for Aleksei Bespechnyi, based in Linz, Austria.

## Executive Summary
Aleksei Bespechnyi is an International Sales and Business Development professional.
Currently enrolled in the 1st year of the Master of Arts programme in Global Sales and Marketing at FH Upper Austria (Campus Steyr, 2026–2028).
Completed his Bachelor of Arts in Global Sales & Marketing in June 2026 at FH Upper Austria.
Independent living and studying in Austria since age 14, combining cross-cultural fluency, commercial acumen, and hands-on digital sales execution.

## Mindset & Strategic Philosophy
Marketing attracts attention, but sustainable growth requires converting attention into qualified pipeline and revenue.
Aleksei focuses on the entire growth engine:
1. Identifying and validating international target markets.
2. Building structured outreach and high-trust B2B relationships.
3. Aligning pricing architectures with customer willingness-to-pay and usage dynamics.
4. Leveraging data analytics, AI tools, and content to scale sales velocity.

## Major Applied Research & Projects
### 1. Nimbuscloud (B2B SaaS, Linz) — Pricing & Gamification Strategy
- Conducted with Steyr-based startup Nimbuscloud (CRM and ticketing platform for dance schools across DACH). Supervised by FH-Prof. Dr. Christopher Korntner-Kanitz.
- Pricing Analysis: Analyzed empirical usage and revenue data of 306 dance schools across 4 pricing tiers. Discovered only 1 customer was on their optimal package. Quantified ~€108,000/month in unrealized revenue potential and designed a 3-tier pricing model enabling +92% revenue upside.
- Gamification Framework: Created a dual B2C/B2B retention system using Hexad user types, streak mechanics, achievement badges, leaderboards, and mascot-led engagement ('Dance Buddy').
- Real-World Impact: Key elements (tiered pricing and volume/API billing) were incorporated into Nimbuscloud's live commercial model.

### 2. voestalpine Steel Division — B2B Dynamic Pricing Report
- Collaborative 12-student study supervised by Dr. Andreas Zehetner (2025) investigating dynamic pricing mechanisms for industrial steel markets.
- Primary Research: Executed on-site empirical survey at Bauma 2025 in Munich (111 validated decision-maker responses) and four in-depth C-level expert interviews (including CEO of RemAvtoSnab).
- Case Studies: RemAvtoSnab (price software, margin caps under Resolution 713) and ArcelorMittal (index-linked contracts, surcharge models, commodity hedging).
- Bachelor Thesis: 'How AI can boost qualitative and quantitative research methodologies in B2B: The case of Voestalpine in the Railway Sector'.

### 3. partyboss.at — Growth & Digital Acquisition
- Built sales and digital presence from zero for a newly launched rental and event brand.
- Achieved +496% organic social reach (engagement rate increased from 60% to 80.5%).
- Achieved +124% organic search traffic (sessions from 383 to 858, engagement up to 70.6%).
- CEO Recommendation from Sascha Reischl (Roll Out Innovation GmbH): 'Aleksei proved in just three months that he understands digital marketing. The numbers speak for themselves... He works independently, thinks strategically, and delivers results.'

### 4. MeinBezirk.at Columnist & Author
- Authored 11 in-depth regional and business articles covering Linz, Steyr, university life, gastronomy, voestalpine, and urban trends.
- Accumulated over 27,000 organic readers across upper Austrian regional media.
